metadata.description: What each UAE-relevant loyalty currency is worth in fils per point. DP-value is the rate we use in card reviews. Floor (worst-case) and ceiling (premium-cabin sweet spot) bracket the realistic range.

query-valuations.answer:
Floor = worst-case redemption (economy cash-vs-points on the programme's own metal). Ceiling = premium-cabin sweet spot on partner award space, on routes UAE residents fly. DP value is what we use in our own card reviews.

auditObservations: 'Baselines confirmed: 10 June 2026' is 88 days before the probe date (2026-09-06). It crosses the site's own 90-day refresh threshold on 2026-09-08 — two days from now.
'Floor/ceiling ranges land with the methodology page, Q3 2026 per editorial calendar.' Q3 2026 ends 2026-09-30 — 24 days left on a public commitment.

The meta description already advertises 'Floor (worst-case) and ceiling (premium-cabin sweet spot) bracket the realistic range' while the page body says those ranges have not landed yet — the description describes columns the page admits are placeholders.

directQuote mode returned sentences only, not table cells, so the dash placeholders themselves were not quoted; their existence is implied by the 'ranges land ... Q3 2026' line. A markdown scrape of the table would confirm the literal dashes.
Response was a Firecrawl cache hit from 10:07Z today, not a fresh fetch.
